conversion_rule: SNK Neo Geo buttons + motions -> Tekken-style inputs. A (LP)=1, C (HP)=2, B (LK)=3, D (HK)=4. f/b/d/u directions map directly. qcf/qcb/dp/hcb/hcf/qcf+hcb/qcb+hcf/qcf,qcf/qcb,qcb/rdp motions preserved. Close-only throws = 1+3-family. Charge motions noted, Tekken input keeps the end direction+button. Colliding inputs get a ~variant suffix on the key only; entry.input keeps the true input. XIV data primary; XV deltas recorded in notes. MI-series stylish strings (SM13-24) added 2026-10-22 from snk.fandom.com; exact MI2 in-game button sequences pending ISO extraction verification.
game: KOF XIV / KOF XV / KOF: Maximum Impact 1&2
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input
